notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for your feedback and messages! I continue to improve the game and fix the bugs.
The new version fixes problems with the basement, fixed the flickering light problem, as well as some other shortcomings.

Many thanks to user Vulcan and HORROR GAMES channel for their help in improving the game.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thanks to your feedback, I continue to improve the game and fix the bugs.
The new version has significantly redesigned lighting, added brightness control. 
Removed post-processing effects blurring the image. 
Expanded a game soundtrack and improved tooltips. 
Fixed bugs related to the game interface, collision system, saving and loading.

Many thanks to users brull255, oleg06.22.1991 and Droogie4Ever for their help in improving the game.

If you find a bug or have any problems, feel free to contact me (yuskare.games@gmail.com).
